```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets) 
library(modelr)
library(mgcv)
```

## LIDAR data:
```{r}
## Load Data:
data("lidar")
```

```{r}
lidar_df = 
  lidar |> 
  mutate(id = row_number()) |> 
  select(id, everything())

lidar_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point()
```

## Build train and test data sets:
```{r}
train_df = sample_frac(lidar_df, size = 0.8)
test_df  = anti_join(lidar_df, train_df, by = "id")
```

```{r}
ggplot(train_df, aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_point(data = test_df, color = "red")
```

## Fit some models:
```{r}
linear_mod = lm(logratio ~ range, data = train_df)
smooth_mod = gam(logratio ~ s(range), data = train_df)
wiggle_mod = gam(logratio ~ s(range, k = 100), sp = 10e-6, data = train_df)
```

## Make a plot:
```{r}
train_df |> 
  add_predictions(linear_mod) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red")

train_df |> 
  add_predictions(smooth_mod) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red")

train_df |> 
  add_predictions(wiggle_mod) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red")
```

## Do a model comparison:
```{r}
rmse(linear_mod, test_df)
rmse(smooth_mod, test_df) 
rmse(wiggle_mod, test_df)
```

## Repeat:
```{r}
cv_df = 
  crossv_mc(lidar_df, 100) |> 
  mutate(
    train = map(train, as_tibble),
    test = map(test, as_tibble)
  ) 
```






## Lets fit models and get RMSE:

```{r}
cv_df = 
  cv_df |> 
  mutate(
    linear_fit = map(train, \(df) lm(logratio ~ range, data = df)),
    smooth_fit = map(train, \(df) gam(logratio ~ s(range), data = df)),
    wiggle_fit = map(train, \(df) gam(logratio ~ s(range, k = 30), sp = 10e-6, data = df))
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    rmse_linear = map2_dbl(linear_fit, test, rmse),
    rmse_smooth = map2_dbl(smooth_fit, test, rmse),
    rmse_wiggle = map2_dbl(wiggle_fit, test, rmse)
  )
  
```

## Look:
```{r}
cv_df |> 
  select(starts_with("rmse_")) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("rmse_"),
               names_to = "model",
               names_prefix = "rmse_",
               values_to = "rmse") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = rmse)) +
  geom_violin()
```


## Child growth:
```{r}
growth_df = 
  read_csv("https://p8105.com/data/nepalese_children.csv") |> 
  mutate(
    weight_ch7 = (weight > 7) * (weight - 7)
  )
```


## Look at data:
```{r}
growth_df

growth_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = weight, y = armc)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5) 
```

```{r}
linear_fit = lm(armc ~ weight, data = growth_df)
smooth_fit = gam(armc ~ s(weight), data = growth_df)
pwl_fit = lm(armc ~ weight + weight_ch7 , data = growth_df)

growth_df |> 
  add_predictions(smooth_fit) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = weight, y = armc)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red")
  
```

```{r}
cv_df = 
  crossv_mc(growth_df, 100) |> 
  mutate(
    train = map(train, as_tibble),
    test = map(test, as_tibble)
  ) 

cv_df = 
  cv_df |> 
  mutate(
    linear_fit = map(train, \(df) lm(armc ~ weight, data = df)),
    smooth_fit = map(train, \(df) gam(armc ~ s(weight), data = df)),
    pwl_fit = map(train, \(df) lm(armc ~ weight + weight_ch7, data = df))
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    rmse_linear = map2_dbl(linear_fit, test, rmse),
    rmse_smooth = map2_dbl(smooth_fit, test, rmse),
    rmse_pwl = map2_dbl(pwl_fit, test, rmse)
  )

```
```{r}
cv_df |> 
  select(starts_with("rmse_")) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("rmse_"),
               names_to = "model",
               names_prefix = "rmse_",
               values_to = "rmse") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = rmse)) +
  geom_violin()
```
